source.name: FC Schalke 04: FC Schalke 04 welcomes Blåkläder as its new sleeve partner
source.quote: Starting with the 2026/2027 season, FC Schalke 04 will welcome the internationally renowned workwear specialist Blåkläder as its new sleeve and main partner.

note: Sleeve and main partner from 2026/27; branding on the sleeves of the first team's jerseys and training kits. The announcement gives no value or term.
